newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura asset management firms say to merge in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Sakura asset management firms say to merge in Oct.

text.p: Two investment management firms in the Sakura Bank Ltd group said on Thursday they would merge on October 1.
Sakura Investment Trust Management Co Ltd and Sakura Asset Management Co Ltd said they will merge on an equal basis to create a new company, Sakura Investment Management Co Ltd.
The new firm will be capitalised at 1.28 billion yen, and Sakura Asset Management will dissolve on the merger.

The companies said in a statement that the planned merger would be aimed at strengthening asset management ability and offering better services under likely tough competition stemming from Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms.
